name: Shrinking Pains
source:
Did your ceiling always look like that?

Your vision peels at the edges, folding in. Everything is white, empty. You spend a day seeing how many coins you can fit into the hollows above your collarbones. 

You wonder how long it will take until there is nothing left of you to touch.

[From [url=https://bedtimephobias.itch.io/shrinking-pains]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的天花板一直是那個樣子嗎？

視野從邊緣剝落、摺疊。四周白茫茫一片，什麼也沒有。你花了一天時間，看自己能把多少硬幣塞進鎖骨上方的凹陷。

你想知道，還要多久，自己就會沒有任何可觸碰的部分。

[來源：[url=https://bedtimephobias.itch.io/shrinking-pains]Itch.io[/url]]
